The CFO Dive article "Super Micro's protracted internal control repairs draw scrutiny" (republished May 22, 2026) reports that the company's fix for its internal financial control weaknesses has run into a second year, which accounting experts are questioning.

- **The weaknesses persist:** In its 10-Q, the company said its material weaknesses in internal control over financial reporting remained unremediated as of March 31. The weaknesses were first identified in February 2025, and the company said it will continue to take actions to improve its internal and disclosure controls until the remediation effort is complete.
- **Remediation steps:** Those efforts include improving its enterprise resource planning system, using checklists to improve accuracy and adding controls to its close process for such issues as related party transactions.
- **Expert concern:** Nicole Wright, an accounting associate professor at James Madison University, said unresolved material weaknesses raise the risk of a "material mistake." She also said that in her experience as an auditor, such weaknesses were fixed quickly, so a fix lasting more than a year is surprising.
- **Auditor opinions:** BDO issued an adverse opinion on the company's internal controls in its fiscal 2024 10-K, and it issued another opinion on controls in the most recent 10-K for fiscal 2025, which found the company did not maintain effective internal control.
- **Leadership context:** A 2024 independent special committee recommended a new CFO. Long-time CFO David Weigand stepped down from the post, effective immediately, and Super Micro then appointed former Western Digital CFO Mark Long to succeed him.

The search results don't clearly tie the ERP-related delays to a specific cause beyond the article's note that remediation is linked to the ERP implementation.

## SMCI FY2026 10-K 重大誤述風險評分：**55 / 100（中高）**

這是我依公開資訊做的判斷，不是統計模型的輸出。我沒能讀到審計意見與 Item 9A 全文，所以這個分數有明顯的不確定性。

### 推升風險的因素

1. **內控持續無效，已拖兩年。** 10-K 結論為 FY2026 財報內控無效（[SEC 10-K](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001375365/000137536526000022/smci-20260630.htm)）。重大缺陷最早於 2025 年 2 月發現，到 2026 年 3 月的 10-Q 仍「未補救」（[CFO Dive](https://www.cfodive.com/news/super-micros-protracted-internal-control-repairs-draw-scrutiny-accounting/821042/)）。截至 2026 年 9 月季的 10-Q 仍認定揭露控制無效，缺陷指向 IT 一般控制（[SEC 10-Q](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001375365/000137536526000027/smci-20260930.htm)）。這是最主要的風險來源。
2. **財務報導基礎變動大。** EY 在 2024 年辭任，由 BDO 接手；長期 CFO Weigand 離任，Mark Long 於 2026 年 10 月 15 日接任（[CFO Dive](https://www.cfodive.com/news/super-micros-cfo-out-change-accounting-leadership-ai/833213/)）。10-K 也提到公司過去曾延遲申報。
3. **現金流與營運數字波動大。** 經營活動現金流為 -$68.1 億，前一年為 +$16.6 億；financing 流入約 $94.8 億。Q3 單季流出約 $66 億、Q4 轉正（[TIKR](https://www.tikr.com/blog/super-micro-burned-6-8-billion-last-year-heres-what-changed-in-june)）。這種波動會提高營運現金流分類、截止期與應收應付認列出錯的機會。
4. **資產負債表科目集中、估值風險高。** 存貨約 $129 億、應收約 $61 億；前三大客戶占應收 52.6%，單一供應商占採購 63.1%（[Stockti](https://stockti.com/super-micro-revenue-surges-78-but-margin-pressures-and-control-gaps-linger)）。存貨跌價與收入認列都是常見的錯誤來源。
5. **外部調查未完全結束。** 2026 年 3 月起有三名相關人員遭起訴（出口管制），SEC、DOJ、BIS 等也有傳票，10-K 稱調查「仍在進行」（[SEC 10-K](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001375365/000137536526000022/smci-20260630.htm)）。
6. **毛利率下滑。** FY2026 毛利率 10.8%，前一年 11.1%，公司表示是為搶市占而降價（10-K MD&A）。

### 降低風險的因素

1. **沒有重編財報。** 10-K 封面的重編勾選框未勾選，我在 MD&A 也沒看到重編揭露。
2. **獨立董事調查結論偏正面。** 2026 年 8 月公布的調查報告稱，沒有證據顯示現任高階管理層知悉規避管制的行為，並認定先前已發布的財務報表仍然可靠（[Morningstar/BusinessWire](https://www.morningstar.com/news/business-wire/20260820294441/supermicro-announces-completion-of-independent-investigation-and-continued-enhancement-of-export-compliance-program)）。這是公司的說法，我未能核實完整報告。
3. **有外部審計師持續審計。** BDO 仍為審計師，10-K 也沒有持續經營的重大不確定性用語。
4. **按時申報。** 申報日為 2026 年 8 月 31 日（[Bullfincher](https://bullfincher.io/companies/super-micro-computer/report/2026-10-k)）。

### 我沒能驗證的部分

- **審計報告意見類型**與**查核師對 ICFR 的意見**（我讀不到 Item 8 與 Item 9A）。
- **重大缺陷的具體領域**。二手來源說是 IT 一般控制、IT 使用者權限與程式監控、職務分離、關係人交易與 ERP 相關，但我無法對照原文確認。
- **Legal Proceedings 與或有事項附註**的完整內容。

這些若能讀到，分數會明顯調整：

- **若財報意見為無保留，且重大缺陷不涉及收入、存貨、應收，** 可降到約 35–40。
- **若出現重編、財報意見附保留或不利、或缺陷延伸到收入與存貨，** 會升到 70 以上。

### 建議下一步

請直接讀 SEC 原文的 **Item 8（審計報告）、Item 9A、Item 3** 三段。如果你要的是投資或盡職調查用途，我可以把重大缺陷的描述逐條對照原文做成表格。
